readings.moment: The temple struck ten, while Girard was looking at his watch.
When the temple struck ten, his watch showed four minutes to ten.
He went out into the street.
The piano started up in the salon as he lit his cigar.
He heard faint quick bells from the master's window above, while the piano was playing.
He came back into the house.
The hall clock had just struck eleven when he came back in.
The face of the hall clock showed two minutes past eleven.

durations: The piano played from 10:29 to 10:42, about 13 minutes (implied: it started at 10:29 and stopped at 10:42 by Girard's watch, and was playing all the while the bells were heard).
Girard was in the street from 10:21 until he came back in at 10:46, about 25 minutes (implied by his going out at 10:21 and returning at 10:46 by his watch).
Girard was in the street for about 8 minutes before the piano started, from 10:21 to 10:29 (implied by his going out at 10:21 and the piano starting as he lit his cigar at 10:29).
About 4 minutes passed between the piano stopping at 10:42 and Girard coming back in at 10:46 (implied by his watch readings).
whereabouts: Girard came to dinner at Monnier's because Monnier asked him.
Girard quarrelled with Monnier about the price at the dinner table, and half the table heard it.
After dinner Girard sat alone in the dining room with the brandy.
Girard went out into the street at 10:21 by his watch.
Girard stayed under the front windows of the house after going out into the street.
Girard was in the street when he lit his cigar and when the piano started.
Girard was in the street when he heard the bells at 10:34 by his watch.
Girard was in the street and could not see who was at the piano.
Girard came back into the house at 10:46 by his watch.
Girard went upstairs to Félix in the library.
Girard knew Félix was in the library.
Girard did not play cards with Dr Vauthier this evening.
